description: This file provides polyfill implementations for the heapq module, replacing certain functions with substitutes that may be used for compatibility or testing purposes. It imports the original heapq module, overrides specific functions with substituted versions, and manages module imports dynamically.

methods.name: _save_and_remove_modules
methods.description: Removes specified modules from sys.modules and saves their original references.

methods.name: import_fresh_module
methods.description: Imports a module fresh by temporarily removing it and any blocked modules from sys.modules.
